paragraphs.text: Core Superpowers-zh engineering skills for DeepSeek Harness
Superpowers-zh core engineering skills packaged for DeepSeek Harness.
Restart the DSH Web service after installation. The bundle registers `brainstorming`, `writing-plans
This is a thin DSH adapter. It ships only the eight listed upstream Markdown skills and does not inc
lude Pi-specific extensions, workflow runners, credentials, or local configuration.
The skills are copied from jnMetaCode/superpowers-zh, licensed under MIT. `UPSTREAM-LICENSE` preserv
es the upstream license text. This adapter is also MIT licensed.
